title: A review round is recorded at the head it read before any fix is pushed
why: On #2015 and #2025 round 3 was not recorded at its head before fixes landed, so `merge --review-record --fix-check` refused and the fix check became prose that `merge --reviewed` cannot read.
note: Filed 09:23 CST Nov 8 from lane bg-tail-loses-verdict (its own mistake). Harm: runner 8 gets a record it may not parse, or a lane fakes the round's head. Guard ideas: lane lint or a push guard asks on a push to a PR branch whose finished round has no record at its head; or `--fix-check` takes the reviewed head named in the reviewer's report. Second idea touches step fix-check-chain (lane session_013NEJKzYhDtNPLcEdeVFEVe); the building lane checks it first. Second sighting 09:40 CST Nov 8 (coordinator): lane notes-fix-report on #2026 and #2068 pushed fixes before it posted the record at the reviewed head, and a fresh chain of three rounds followed.
